what: Per-player game logs (minutes, points, rebounds, assists, steals, blocks, turnovers, shooting, and the opponent) for every player whose row reconciled arithmetically in the official gamebook.
acceptance_rule: a player row is accepted only if PTS == 2*FG + 3P + FT, TOT == OR + DR, FGM<=FGA, 3PM<=3PA, FTM<=FTA, 3PM<=FGM, and the row has gamebook shape (at most three non-empty cells before MIN).
